$comment: Mechanically-enforced gate baselines (see EVALS.md rules). run-routing.mjs prints a gate verdict on every run and exits 1 on breach when invoked with --gate (CI does). Re-baselining is an explicit act: update these numbers in the same commit as the change that moves them, with the decision recorded in Solo (EVALS.md rule 1). Counts are absolute hits, not percentages.
note: Re-baselined for Scout 1.8.28 operation/routing drift and the current ecosystem-skills mirrors. Four public read-only Scout collections were exposed (24 of 28 operations); existing upstream summaries and x-routing also changed. The prior committed legacy baseline was 209/285/316 (2026-07-13), which main's catalog no longer matched; measured pristine-main pre-change was 210/282/318, so this drift's actual legacy-strict effect is 210/282/318 -> 210/282/317 (one top-5 loss). Extended strict measured 93/110/117. The skills lane retained 23/23 top-3, top-5, and card@5; its top-1 floor moved 18 -> 17 because q-skill-builder-quickstart-remittance now ranks the newly sharpened Scout project/prior-art lookup first and the intended builder-quickstart skill second. That mixed query explicitly asks for prior art, the expected skill remains top-3/card@5, and weakening accurate Scout routing to preserve the old strict winner was rejected. No runner operation intersects this drift. Prior baseline: routing-2026-07-13T08-54-21-839Z.json (skills-form arm-B ship).
